name: SwipeForge
description: Generate videos, images and posts with SwipeForge, follow their progress and publish to your connected accounts after you approve each post.
skill: SwipeForge creates short videos, images, captions and audio and publishes them to the user's social accounts. Start with get_connection. If it is not connected, call connect and ask the user to sign in on the SwipeForge page that opens in their browser and press Allow, then poll get_connection. To create: list_models for the type, estimate_generation with type, prompt, provider_id and model (plus duration_seconds, resolution and aspect_ratio for video), tell the user the estimate, then generate. Generations count against the account's SwipeForge level, not a separate budget. Keep request_id to retry a timed-out call. Generation runs in the background: poll get_creation until status is success or failed. To publish: list_accounts, prepare_post with content_id, account_id and mode, which opens an approval page; after the user approves (get_post_approval shows approved), call publish_approved. Ask before delete_creation, cancel_post and disconnect and pass confirm=true. Everything else in SwipeForge (templates, folders, media, avatars, Canva, tracking, analytics, notifications) is reachable through list_swipeforge_tools and call_swipeforge_tool. Connecting social accounts and every approval happen in the browser; never ask for passwords.
